description: This file extends the ChannelsStore class to implement lifecycle-related methods, including starting/stopping polling, refreshing status, managing WhatsApp login flow, and other channel logout functionalities.

classes.name: WhatsAppLoginStartResult
classes.description: Holds the response data for starting WhatsApp login, including QR code URL and message.

classes.name: WhatsAppLoginWaitResult
classes.description: Contains the result of waiting for WhatsApp login, indicating connection status and message.

classes.name: ChannelLogoutResult
classes.description: Represents the outcome of a channel logout operation, including whether credentials were cleared.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins polling and periodic refresh of the ChannelsStore if not in preview mode and no existing poll task.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the polling task for ChannelsStore.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the current status snapshot from the GatewayConnection, updating internal state and handling errors.

methods.name: startWhatsAppLogin
methods.description: Initiates a WhatsApp login process, optionally auto-waiting for completion.

methods.name: waitWhatsAppLogin
methods.description: Waits for the WhatsApp login process to complete, with a specified timeout.

methods.name: logoutWhatsApp
methods.description: Logs out from WhatsApp and clears credentials.

methods.name: logoutTelegram
methods.description: Logs out from Telegram, updating configuration status accordingly.
